rule.name: ListUsedAsSet
rule.message: This local list gets add and is searched with contains inside a loop or stream step, so every search scans the whole list. Keep it in a Set (new HashSet<>(), or LinkedHashSet to keep insertion order): add returns false when the item is already there. An exception fits only for a list that always stays a handful of items.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $positional := ('get', 'set', 'indexOf', 'lastIndexOf', 'subList', 'listIterator', 'sort', 'replaceAll', 'getFirst', 'getLast', 'addFirst', 'addLast', 'removeFirst', 'removeLast', 'reversed'), $repeats := ('ForeachStatement', 'ForStatement', 'WhileStatement', 'DoStatement'), $iterating := ('forEach', 'forEachOrdered', 'map', 'flatMap', 'filter', 'anyMatch', 'allMatch', 'noneMatch', 'peek', 'removeIf', 'mapToObj', 'mapToInt', 'mapToLong', 'mapToDouble', 'takeWhile', 'dropWhile') return //MethodCall[@MethodName = 'contains'][ArgumentList/@Size = 1][*[1][self::VariableAccess]] [let $call := ., $name := *[1]/@Name, $block := ancestor::Block[LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId[@Name = $name]][1], $declarator := $block/LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator[VariableId/@Name = $name], $uses := $block//MethodCall[*[1][self::VariableAccess[@Name = $name]]] return exists($declarator/ConstructorCall[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.ArrayList') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.LinkedList')]) and $declarator << $call and exists($uses[@MethodName = 'add'][ArgumentList/@Size = 1]) and empty($uses[@MethodName = $positional]) and empty($uses[@MethodName = 'add'][ArgumentList/@Size = 2]) and empty($uses[@MethodName = 'remove'][ArgumentList/*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('int')]]) and exists($call/ancestor::*[local-name() = $repeats or self::LambdaExpression[parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = $iterating] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.stream.BaseStream') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Iterable') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')]]]][. >> $declarator])]
